descFull: Open-source alternative to HeyMelody and realme Link for Android, Windows and Linux. Control OnePlus, OPPO and realme earbuds over Bluetooth, no root: noise control, equalizer, hearing profile, gestures, wear detection, find my earbuds, dual connection, low latency, widgets and a tray panel.
